anti_fallbacks.why: That desk does not exist in the runtime art, so the result would manufacture false continuity and make an unsupported fidelity claim.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Put a decorative room banner above an ordinary stacked Goal card.
anti_fallbacks.why: The room would become wallpaper and the active commitment would return to a generic dashboard composition.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Give Today's three, Review goal, Make this smaller, Workshop, or New goal a second luminous card or action treatment.
anti_fallbacks.why: Those routes support the current commitment and must not compete with the exact next Quest.

first_real_slice.real_inputs: Production-equivalent active Goal, live current Quest, selected daily field, recovery action, Workshop and New goal doors, canonical Goals room art, and existing opening/detail routes.

first_real_slice.state_boundary: This pass must not modify Goal planning, Quest completion, daily-field priority, recovery state, route identity, or persisted data; it changes only the active-return composition and material treatment.
